FAIL_TO_PASS: cycles-stack-overflow: does not stack overflow on crazy cyclical dependencies
tdz-common: preserve common TDZ violations
class-fields: supports class fields
deoptimized-props-with-getter: handles fully deoptimized objects
dynamic-import-this-arrow: uses correct "this" in dynamic imports when using arrow functions
preserve-for-of-iterable: preserves for...of loops
consistent-renaming-d: consistent renaming test d
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
supports-core-js: supports core-js
known-getter: handles known getters that modify "this"
side-effect-e: accounts for local scopes when tested function purity
unknown-property-access: handles getters that modify "this" for unknown property access
tagged-template-deoptimize: correctly deoptimizes tagged template expressions
es5-class-called-without-new: does not swallow type errors when running constructor functions without "new"
side-effects-this: When a constructor is called with the new keyword, changing its this has no side effects
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
minimal-this-mutation: mutates "this" only if necessary on function calls
unmodified-default-exports: does not treat property assignment as rebinding for sake of unbound default exports
parameter-call-mutation: tracks mutations of function parameters when called
redeclare-parameter-var-function: allows to redeclare parameters as var or function
